items.value: Share compare results outside the platform

turns.text: Thanks, that is clear: you want to share comparison results with people who have no account. Who is affected and how often does it happen? What do you do today?

items.value: One PDF per comparison with the charts and the table

arguments.title: PDF export of the compare page
arguments.summary: Export the compare page as a PDF so results can be shared without an account.
arguments.description: Add an export action to the Compare page that produces a PDF containing the charts, the metric table and the selected runs, so that analysts can share results with people who do not have an account.
arguments.business_need: Share comparison results with people outside the platform.
arguments.justification: Five analysts do this weekly with screenshots, which loses the table and is slow.

priority.reasoning: Useful with a workaround; a team repeats the manual step weekly.

complexity.reasoning: About a week: a new export path in one area with layout work.
